GTK backend for ui/hostwindow.nim.

The SDL window is embedded under the menu bar of the shared GTK top-level (gtkshell.nim), so the window operations act on that top-level rather than on the SDL window directly. The one exception is the close button: it arrives as a GTK delete-event and is turned into an ordinary SDL_QUIT, so the application's single shutdown path handles it like every other quit.
